headline: Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3 models for real-time voice agents
body: Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system includes a speech-to-text model, a text-to-speech model and a voice agent SDK based on LiveKit, and transcription covers more than 50 languages.
note: For banks, the option to run it on their own infrastructure is the part that bears on control of data, as Mistral describes it.

evidence.text: Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents.
The system includes a speech-to-text model (Voxtral Small Transcribe 3), a text-to-speech model (Voxtral Mini TTS 3), and a voice agent SDK based on LiveKit.
Mistral says the system can run on your own infrastructure or through EU-hosted APIs to keep data under your control.
